description: Takes people with role and self or manager ratings 1 to 5 for ten procurement capabilities (need, market, tender, nego, contract, srm, spend, p2p, risk, stake) or for the user's own profile, compares them with the target per role (buyer, category manager, procurement business partner, S2P lead; suggested targets marked as such) and returns per person the average gap, the largest gaps and a verdict (ready for a stretch role, develop selectively, coaching plan), plus three training priorities for the team and a 30, 60, 90 day path. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

people.description: Rows: name (or role label), role, scores {need, market, tender, nego, contract, srm, spend, p2p, risk, stake} each 1 to 5.

profile.description: Optional own profile: capability and target level 1 to 5; scores then use the capability names as keys.

capability.description: Name of the capability, e.g. negotiation.

name: assess_team
title: Capability gaps per person and team against a role profile: who is ready for more, who needs a coaching plan, three training priorities
